methods.label: Substitution and fraction division
methods.explanation:
Substitute \(a=2\) and \(\sin A=1/2\ne0\). Dividing by \(1/2\) means multiplying by \(2\), so
\[
\frac{a}{\sin A}=2\div(1/2)=2\times2=4.
\]
